newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-PENN MAKES NEW ZEALAND DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PENN MAKES NEW ZEALAND DEBUT.

text.p: Swing bowler Andrew Penn made his debut for New Zealand in the second and final one-day international against Sri Lanka on Thursday.
The New Zealanders, expecting the pitch at Wellington's Basin Reserve to assist the seam bowlers, preferred Penn, 22, to spinner Daniel Vettori.
Sri Lanka, who won Tuesday's match in Christchurch by six wickets, won the toss and asked New Zealand to bat first. They named an unchanged side.
New Zealand - Stephen Fleming (captain), Nathan Astle, Bryan Young, Matt Horne, Chris Cairns, Chris Harris, Adam Parore, Gavin Larsen, Simon Doull, Heath Davis, Andrew Penn

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Roshan Mahanama, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekaratne, Kumar Dharmasena, Upul Chandana, Chaminda Vaas, Nuwan Zoysa, Muttiah Muralitharan
